Label: Navajo Code Talkers
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Take a Bolster card from your hand and place it face down on the table. You may use it as if it were a Response card.

Label: Oil Embargo
Text: Germany, Italy, and Japan must each choose to remove a piece from the board or discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck.

Label: Rangers
Text: Use when you deploy or marshal an Air Force. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to eliminate an Army adjacent to that Air Force.

Label: Pappy Boyington
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to deploy an Air Force in or adjacent to the Central Pacific.

Label: Our Philosophy of Government
Text: Use at the beginning of your Draw step. Discard the top 2 cards of your draw deck to allow the United Kingdom to place a Response card from its discard pile face down on the table.

Label: War Bonds
Text: When you Reallocate Resources, you may take a card from your discard pile instead of your draw deck.

Label: Flying Tigers
Text: Use at the beginning of your Air step. Deploy a Chinese Air Force, or a Chinese Air Force may gain air superiority.

Label: Eagle Squadrons
Text: Use at the beginning of your Air step. The United Kingdom may deploy an Air Force.

Label: USMC
Text: Use when you build a Navy in or adjacent to a sea space with 'Pacific' in the title. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to battle a land space adjacent to the Navy just built.

Label: Pacific Bases
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to recruit an Army in a space adjacent to the Central Pacific.

Label: Shoot First and Argue Afterwards
Text: Build a Navy in a sea space with 'Pacific' in the title, then battle a sea space adjacent to the Navy just built.

Label: The Brazilian Expeditionary Force
Text: Build an Army in Latin America and a Navy in the South Atlantic or the Southern Ocean.

Label: Cash and Carry Replaces Neutrality Acts
Text: Recruit any 1 available Allied Army or Navy in or adjacent to the corresponding country's Home space.

Label: American Public Sympathizes with Chinese People
Text: Build a Chinese Army.

Label: A Great, Sleeping Giant
Text: Use when you build a Navy in a space with 'Pacific' in the title. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to build an Army or Navy in an adjacent space.

Label: P-51 Mustang
Text: Use when you play an Economic Warfare card. The country attacked must discard an additional card for each United States Air Force within 2 spaces of the opponent's Home space.

Label: Anti-Japanese Volunteer Armies
Text: Each time a Chinese Army is battled, built, or recruited, the Japanese player must discard 1 card from its hand.

Label: Carpet Bombing
Text: Use when you battle. Discard an Economic Warfare card from your hand to battle the same space again.

Label: Doolittle's Bombers
Text: Use if you have a supplied Navy within 3 spaces of Japan. Japan must discard the top 1 card of its draw deck. Gain 3 Victory Points.

Label: Artificial Harbors
Text: Use once per turn when you build a Navy. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to build an Army adjacent to the Navy just built.

Label: SHAEF
Text: France, the United States, and the United Kingdom may trace supply through each other's pieces, including the Army in the Supply space.

Label: Victory Gardens
Text: The United States only has to discard 1 card from its hand to use Reallocate Resources.

Label: Stalemate in China
Text: For each Chinese Army or Air Force on the board, Japan must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck.

Label: The Hundred Regiments Offensive
Text: Battle a land space adjacent to a supplied Chinese piece.

Label: United States Submarines Patrol Japanese Shipping Lanes
Text: For each United States Navy within 2 spaces of Japan, Japan must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck.

Label: Admiral Graf Spee
Text: Use when you build a Navy. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to battle the North Sea, North Atlantic, or South Atlantic.

Label: Ju-52's Airlift Supplies
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. If you have an Air Force on the board, all German pieces are in supply for the rest of the turn.

Label: Operation Weserübung
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to recruit an Army in Scandinavia.

Label: Fallschirmjäger
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to battle a land space adjacent to your Air Force.

Label: Sweden Supports Finland
Text: To use, Germany or the Soviet Union must have an Army in Russia. Build a Navy in the Baltic and recruit an Army in Scandinavia.

Label: 12.8cm Flakzwilling 40
Text: Use when an Allied player gains air superiority to eliminate an Italian Air Force. The Air Force used to gain air superiority is eliminated.

Label: Elektroboot Submarines
Text: The Allied country of your choice must discard the top 1 card of its draw deck. Gain +2 Victory Points.

Label: Tactical Innovations
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Discard your Status card from the table to place a Status card from your hand on the table.

Label: Landkreuzers
Text: Use every time a German Army is battled. The country initiating the battle must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck.

Label: Westwall
Text: Use every time an Axis Army is battled in Germany. The country initiating the battle must discard the top 3 cards of its draw deck.

Label: Sea Lion
Text: Build a Navy in the North Sea, then battle the United Kingdom space.

Label: Production Initiative
Text: Take your choice of 1 Status card from your draw deck and play it. Then shuffle your draw deck.

Label: Cloud Cover
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Air Defense cannot be used this turn.

Label: Strategic Planning
Text: Take your choice of 1 or 2 cards from your draw deck and add them to your hand, then discard 1 card from your hand. Shuffle your draw deck.

Label: The Blitz
Text: Use when you play an Economic Warfare card. The United Kingdom must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck for each German Air Force within 2 spaces of the United Kingdom.

Label: Ju-87
Text: Use when you deploy or marshal an Air Force. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to battle a land space adjacent to that Air Force.

Label: Turkey Joins Axis
Text: Build a Navy in the Black Sea, then recruit an Army in the Middle East.

Label: Arkhangelsk Falls
Text: To use, the Axis must have Armies in both Scandinavia and Russia. The Soviet Union must discard the top 5 cards of its draw deck. Gain +1 Victory Point.

Label: Fall Weiss
Text: Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to recruit an Army in Eastern Europe. Then play another card from your hand.

Label: G7e Torpedo
Text: Use when you play an Economic Warfare card with the word "Submarines" in the title. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to battle a sea space.

Label: Tank Desant
Text: Use when you build an Army. Discard both a Build Army card and a Land Battle card from your hand to battle a land space adjacent to the Army just built.

Label: Asian Reserves
Text: Use at the beginning of your Draw step. Take 2 Build Army cards from your discard pile and add them to your hand.

Label: Attrition
Text: During your Discard step, gain +1 Victory Point for each Build Army card you discard from your hand.

Label: Endless Expanses
Text: Use at any time. Do not remove Soviet Armies in Siberia and/or Kazakhstan this turn.

Label: Battles of Khalkhin Gol
Text: Recruit an Army in Mongolia, then battle Vladivostok or China.

Label: Operation Zet
Text: Use at the beginning of your Air step. Deploy a Chinese Air Force, or a Chinese Air Force may gain air superiority.

Label: Fortress Rebuilt
Text: Use at the beginning of your Draw step. Discard a Build Army card from your hand to place a Response card from your discard pile face down on the table.

Label: Zhukov Drives West
Text: Use when you battle Russia, Eastern Europe, Ukraine, or the Balkans. Discard a Build Army card from your hand to build an Army in the space just battled.

Label: Siberian Transfer
Text: Recruit an Army in or adjacent to Siberia.

Label: Paratroops
Text: Use when you deploy or marshal an Air Force. Discard a Build Army card from your hand to build an Army adjacent to that Air Force.

Label: People's Liberation Army
Text: Chinese Armies are always in supply. During your Play step, instead of playing a card from your hand, you may recruit a Chinese Army in Szechuan, China, or Mongolia.

Label: Quantity has a Quality All Its Own
Text: Use once per turn when you build an Army. Discard a Build Army card from your hand to build an additional Army.

Label: Vitebsk Gate
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Discard a Build Army card and 2 other cards from your hand to eliminate an Axis Army in Moscow or Russia.

Label: Kuril Islands Landing Operation
Text: Build a Navy in the Sea of Japan, then battle the Japan space.

Label: Battle of Moscow
Text: Use immediately after your last Army on the board is removed. Discard a Build Army card from your hand to eliminate an Axis Army in or adjacent to Moscow.

Label: Heavy Tanks
Text: Use when your Army is battled. The attacker must discard 4 cards from its hand or your Army is not removed.

Label: Cavalry Corps
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Discard a Build Army card from your hand and eliminate a Soviet Army from the board. Then build an Army.

Label: Government Evacuates to Kuibyshev
Text: Siberia is now the Soviet Union Home space, and a Supply space for the Soviet Union (only). Place a Home space marker on Siberia. Moscow is no longer a Supply space for any country.

Label: Retreat and Regroup
Text: Use when your Army in Moscow or Ukraine is removed. Recruit Armies in both Siberia and Kazakhstan.

Label: Japan Arms Indian Nationalists
Text: Use when you battle in India. Build an Army in India.

Label: Marco Polo Bridge Incident
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Battle in China or an adjacent land space.

Label: Fu-Go Balloon Bombs
Text: Gain +1 Victory Point. Instead of discarding this card, you may discard 3 other cards from hand and return this card to your hand.

Label: Submarines Support Fleet
Text: Use when you build a Navy. Sea battle 1 or 2 times adjacent to the Navy just built.

Label: SNLF Paratroopers
Text: Use when you build a Navy. Land battle 1 or 2 times adjacent to the Navy just built.

Label: Japanese Mandate for the South Seas Islands
Text: During your Victory step, gain +1 Victory Point if you have a Navy in the Central Pacific.

Label: Japanese Fleet Blockades Vladivostok
Text: For each Japanese Navy and Air Force in the Sea of Japan, gain a +1 Victory Point and the Soviet Union must discard the top 1 card of its draw deck.

Label: Kantai Kessen
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Battle a sea space.

Label: Mitsubishi J8M
Text: Use at the beginning of your Draw step. Eliminate an Allied Air Force adjacent to your Air Force.

Label: Absolute National Defense Sphere
Text: During your Victory step, gain +1 Victory Point if you have 3 or more Navies on the board.

Label: Torai
Text: Use when you gain air superiority in or adjacent to the Central Pacific. Discard a Response card from your hand to battle the space from which the enemy Air Force was just removed.

Label: Imperial Japanese Navy
Text: Use when you build a Navy. Discard a Response card from your hand to build an additional Navy.

Label: Nagumo Commands the First Air Fleet
Text: Use when you deploy or marshal an Air Force to a sea space. Discard a Response card from your hand to battle a space adjacent to that Air Force.

Label: Imperial Manchukuo Army
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Recruit an Army in China.

Label: Yamamoto aboard the Yamato
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Discard a Response card from your hand to deploy an Air Force in a space with your supplied Navy.

Label: Bombing of Chongqing
Text: For each Japanese Air Force in or adjacent to Szechuan, gain +1 Victory Point and the United States must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck.

Label: The Pacific Empire
Text: Use during your Victory step. Score +1 Victory Point for each Japanese Navy that occupies a space with "Pacific" in the title.

Label: Island Fortresses
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Discard a Response card from your hand to recruit an Army in Indonesia, New Guinea, Iwo Jima, or the Philippines.

Label: Hokushin-ron
Text: During your Victory step, gain +1 Victory Point for each Army you have in Vladivostok and Siberia.

Label: Chinese Civil War
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Eliminate a Chinese Army.

Label: Thailand
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Recruit an Army in Southeast Asia.

Label: Code of Bushido
Text: Use when your Army is battled. Discard a Response card from your hand and do not remove the Army due to that battle.

Label: Warsaw Uprising
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Discard 2 cards from your hand to recruit an Army in Eastern Europe.

Label: French Patriots Join Allies
Text: Use immediately after the United States, France, or the United Kingdom battles in North Africa, Africa, Middle East, or Western Europe. Recruit a French Army in the space battled.

Label: Bletchley Park
Text: Use when the Axis declares its intention to use a Bolster card, but before any text is resolved. Discard 1 card from hand to discard the Axis Bolster card without resolving its text.

Label: France Combattante
Text: Build a French Army.

Label: Keep Calm and Carry On
Text: Use when the Axis declares its intention to use a Status card, but before any text is resolved. Discard 1 card from your hand to prevent the Axis from using that Status card this turn.

Label: Polish Sovereignty
Text: United Kingdom Armies in Eastern Europe are always in supply. During your Play step, instead of playing a card from hand, you may recruit a United Kingdom Army in Eastern Europe.

Label: Maginot Line
Text: Use at any time. Discard 4 cards from hand to prevent a French Army in Western Europe from being removed this turn.

Label: Les Forces Navales Françaises Libres
Text: Build a French Navy.

Label: Hobart's Funnies
Text: Axis Status cards are ignored during the United Kingdom turn.

Label: Free Forces of the Low Countries
Text: Recruit a French Army in Western Europe, or battle Western Europe if a supplied French piece is adjacent.

Label: Rhin et Danube
Text: Battle a land space adjacent to a supplied French piece.

Label: Armée de l'Air
Text: Use at the beginning of your Air step. Deploy a French Air Force.

Label: Special Air Service Raids Airfields
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Discard 2 cards from your hand to eliminate an Axis Air Force adjacent to your Air Force.

Label: Government in Exile
Text: If Western Europe is occupied by an Axis Army, the United Kingdom is France's Home space.

Label: La Royale
Text: Build a French Navy.

Label: British Colonial Forces
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Discard 2 cards from your hand to recruit an Army in North Africa, Middle East, Southeast Asia, or Indonesia.

Label: Senegalese Tirailleurs
Text: Allied Armies in Africa are always in supply. During your Play step, instead of playing a card from hand, you may recruit a French Army in Africa.

Label: Élan
Text: Use when a French Army is about to be removed. Do not remove that Army this turn.

Label: Polskie Państwo Podziemne
Text: Eliminate an Axis Army in Eastern Europe.

Label: Foreign Legion
Text: Recruit a French Army in Africa, North Africa, Madagascar, Southeast Asia, New Guinea, or the Middle East.

Label: Armée de Terre
Text: Build a French Army.

Label: Turkey Opens the Straits
Text: For the Axis, the Middle East is adjacent to the Balkans, and the Black Sea is adjacent to the Mediterranean Sea.

Label: Spain
Text: Build an Army in Western Europe or North Africa; then build a Navy in the Mediterranean or North Sea.

Label: Supermarina
Text: Use during your Victory step. Gain +1 Victory Point per Italian Navy on the board.

Label: Alpini
Text: Use when your Army is battled in or adjacent to Italy. Do not remove that Army.

Label: BETASOM
Text: Use when Germany plays an Economic Warfare card with the word "Submarines" in its title. The Allied country targeted by the card must discard 3 additional cards from the top of its draw deck.

Label: Pact of Steel
Text: Use at any time. Germany may discard between 0 and 5 cards from its hand, then Italy may take the same number of random cards from its discard pile and place them on top of its draw deck.

Label: Operation Unthinkable
Text: Use immediately after the Soviet Union builds an Army. If the United Kingdom or United States has an Army adjacent to the Soviet Army just built, eliminate that Soviet Army.

Label: Golden Square Coup
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Recruit an Army in the Middle East.

Label: Reza Shah supports Axis
Text: Eliminate an Allied Army in the Middle East.

Label: Operation Pike
Text: If the United Kingdom has an Army within 2 spaces of Ukraine, the Soviet Union must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck. Gain +1 Victory Point.

Label: Spanish Troops Seize Gibraltar
Text: The North Sea and Mediterranean are never adjacent for the Allies, and always adjacent for the Axis.

Label: Regia Aeronautica
Text: Use when you are the target of an Economic Warfare card. Remove your Air Force from the board instead of discarding cards.

Label: Wafdist Uprising
Text: Eliminate an Allied Army in North Africa.

Label: Operation Lobster
Text: The United Kingdom must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck.

Label: Operation Herkules
Text: Recruit an Italian Navy and a German Navy in the Mediterranean.

Label: Giuliani, Cappellini, and Torelli
Text: Germany, Italy, and Japan takes a random card from their discard pile and places it on top of their draw decks. Gain +1 Victory Point.

Label: Italy Completes Carriers
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Discard 1 card from your hand to deploy or marshal an Air Force in a space with your Navy.

Label: Irredentismo Italiano
Text: During your Victory step, gain +1 Victory Point if you have an Army in Western Europe.

Label: Somaliland
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Recruit an Army in Africa.

Label: Ledo and Burma Roads
Text: To use, the Allies must have an Army in Southeast Asia. Recruit a Chinese Army in China or Szechuan, or eliminate an Axis Army in China or Szechuan.

Label: Dutch East Indies
Text: Recruit French Armies in both Indonesia and New Guinea, and a French Navy in the South China Sea.

Label: American Volunteer Group Expands
Text: Allied Armies in Szechuan are always in supply. During your Play step, instead of playing a card from hand, you may recruit a Chinese Army in Szechuan.

Label: Free France
Text: French pieces are always in supply. (Other rules about building new pieces still apply.)

Label: Free French Allies
Text: Recruit 1 or 2 French Armies in Western Europe, Africa, and/or North Africa.
